title: HTML fundamentals
goal: Build a page with meaningful headings, text and links.
explanation: HTML is markup: elements describe the role of content. Most elements have opening and closing tags. Nest elements correctly rather than choosing tags only for their default appearance.
Use one clear main heading for this small page, then organise sections with suitable heading levels. A link navigates to a destination; a button performs an action.
The document language helps assistive technology. The viewport meta tag makes mobile layout behave as expected. Give links useful text rather than repeating “click here”.

Hello, web!

I am learning with JEFF.
exercise: Create an about page with a heading, two paragraphs and a link to another page.
hint: Use h1, p and a with an href attribute.

quiz.question: Which element should navigate to another page?
options: A div with an onclick handler
quiz.explanation: A real link supports keyboard use, opening in a new tab and browser navigation.
